text:
matt: Quick heads-up — seeing a 5-8% p95 latency regression on host ingress for streaming long prompts on canary. Baremetal bench looks fine.

jana: Details? tokenization, parse, or network?

matt: Flame diff points to host parse/serialize work. Top stacks: parse_frame -> readv -> tokenize_loop -> writev. KV hit rate is steady. Suspect batching packing changed CPU profile.

liam: Did batching heuristics change recently? I remember an auto-batch tweak last week.

matt: yeah, auto-batch default moved from 8 -> 12 in ring scheduler (2026-03-10). workload packing increases small-chunk writes.

anya: Also noticed grpc writev syscall rate jump in traces. Chunk sizes smaller -> more syscalls. Could be coalescing regression. :eyes: 

perfbot: benchmark: host_ingress_streaming_canary (2026-03-16 03:12) p95 +6.2% vs baseline, cpu parse_ns +12%. logs: "host_parse: allocs=1200 -> 1700"

matt: snippet from perf top: 
```
# top stacks
parse_frame+0x38  34.2%
readv           12.1%
tokenize_loop    8.7%
writev           7.9%
```

jana: Can we isolate tokenization cost vs framing overhead? quick microbench: send pre-tokenized payloads and compare.

liam: I ran a small bench toggling auto-batch:
- auto-batch=12: p95 +6%
- auto-batch=8: p95 +1.1%

liam: also tried a parse-alloc patch (reduce temporary string copies) — results: p95 -2% (partial).

matt: ok. action plan:
1) rollback auto-batch default on canary to 8 (temporary)
2) merge liam's parse-alloc patch into canary
3) add tracing for writev batch sizes and syscall counts
4) instrument kvcache async fetch tail latency (to rule out hidden stalls)

anya: +1. also validate grpc channel/keepalive changes; small packets can change Nagle/pack behavior.

matt: commands I used for repro: 
```
wrk -t8 -c200 --script=stream.lua --latency http://canary-ingress:8080/generate
# stream.lua uses 1 long prompt, chunked by client
```

matt: opened PRs: <https://redwood-internal/repo/pull/4237|PR#4237> (rollback batch default) and <https://redwood-internal/repo/pull/4241|PR#4241> (parse alloc reductions).

liam: I'll add tracing hooks for writev sizes and push a small metrics export.

anya: assigning to matt/liam. If rollback fixes p95 we'll cut a patch to prod quickly.

matt: will run canary after merge and post results. thanks. :thumbsup:
